title: Downtown Haven
description:
Modern Luxuriously appointed downtown haven. Come and get spoiled. Small breeds of dogs are welcome.Fully fenced in yard. Private driveway. Full amenities. At the end of the evening slide into some of the softest fluffiest towels and sheets you have ever experienced. Relax around the bbq before heading out for the evening.

The space
Located in downtown Nashville but far enough away from all the craziness to make for a quiet nights rest.Everything : Honky tonks,Professional sports , museums , state parks , golf , nightlife, restaurants and the trendy neighborhoods are all within easy reach. The neighborhood is safe and quiet.

Guest access
Entire home is at your disposal . Private driveway and street parking.

Other things to note
Pets of 25 pounds and under are welcome. A nonrefundable deposit is required.
